question_prompt: Q19: In what way are you most likely to approach a promotion?
panels: Q19: In what way are you most likely to approach a promotion?
answers: I would ask for one if I believed I deserved one
Promotions are something I’ll naturally be approached about if I deserve it, so I wouldn’t ask on my own
If my company doesn’t give me the promotion I believe I deserve, I’ll start looking for another job
I would ask for a higher raise than the promotion offered, because why not?
If my company doesn’t give me the promotion I believe I deserve, I’ll quit
